summary: Preserve campaigns ab-test create and results for revision 2026-10-15. Resolve container or message IDs through the shared resolver and reject multi-message containers with selectable message IDs. Create only on one unscheduled draft email variation with no existing ab_test. Copy the original template, sender, reply, CC, BCC and preview fields into one to six distinct subject alternatives B through G; apply winner settings on the message, never schedule or send, and verify subjects, settings and unscheduled draft state from fresh reads. Variation POSTs must have exactly one attempt even with inherited idempotency headers, transport replay or redirects; on create failure, best-effort delete every known variation created in this run and name cleanup failures and ambiguous outcomes. On any settings PATCH error or non-200 response, reconcile from an uncached fresh message read: requested settings keep variations and continue normal verification; null settings roll back created variations; failed reads or different settings keep everything and return an inspection error naming the message and every created variation ID. Dry runs read current evidence without writes. Results require non-null ab_test settings and at least two email variations before status handling or reporting, return too_early before a report call for unsent A/B messages, otherwise auto-resolve the order metric and paginate per-variation campaign values reports within a timezone-aware calendar window capped to 364 days. Join on variation ID, fill missing rows with zeros, compute revenue per recipient and two-sided pooled two-proportion z-tests for the rate leader against every other variation, and emit clear_winner only when every p-value is below 0.05. Include opens privacy and small-sample notes. Infer the Klaviyo rollout winner only for sent messages with positive winner_percentage, after send_time plus winner_wait_hours according to the existing clock seam, and with one strictly largest recipient count; otherwise omit the winner and add a short explanation. Keep registration, novel feature metadata, flags and campaign documentation aligned.
reason: Subject-line tests belong to campaign variations and message ab_test settings in the omnichannel campaign model; replaying creates would duplicate variations, and aggregate campaign totals cannot compare variation performance. Both create and results must label variations by attributes.created ascending, with variation ID as the tie-breaker, so the original variation stays A even when names sort differently.
